correctness.rationale: The exact quartic equation is Veniani Example 5.4. Exhaustive finite-field RREF enumeration covers all 7462 lines of P3(F9), yielding precisely 48 satisfying all five quartic restrictions. Veniani establishes exactly 48 geometric lines, making the finite-field enumeration geometrically exhaustive. The exact Frobenius action has six fixed lines and 21 transpositions. The five restriction equations have Jacobian corank one on their Grassmann charts at exactly seven points (four in the (0,1) chart and three in the (0,2) chart), corank zero at the remaining 41. Since line support is finite, the seven and only seven are nonreduced. Frobenius has one fixed and three conjugate pairs among them. Standard reduced finite étale scheme theory proves all field counts and the reduced-scheme zeta function. Exact Python 3 standard-library verifier accompanies this item. It does not measure local Artin lengths.
